cards.heading: The danger zone
cards.body: Most relapses happen in predictable windows: evenings after work, weekends, and the first hour of free time. Understanding your personal danger windows lets you plan ahead.

cards.question: When are most cannabis relapses most likely to happen?

options.text: Evenings and weekends with unstructured time

cards.explanation: Unstructured free time — especially evenings and weekends — is when most relapses happen. Boredom and habit patterns kick in when there's nothing else filling the space.

cards.heading: Plan the gap
cards.body: For your highest-risk windows, plan something specific in advance. Not 'I'll figure it out' — but an actual activity written down. Vague intentions don't survive a real craving.

cards.prompt: What are your two highest-risk time windows? Write a specific activity you can do during each one this week — something already on your phone or at home.
